strings.name: carriers
strings.text: The man can see the sea. ; The cat sat on the mat. ; All that is done is done, and all that is done cannot be undone. ; The seeds fell deep and the seeds grew and the seeds grew tall. ; The dog saw the cat and the cat saw the dog. ; A good day is a day well spent, and a day well spent is good. ; The sea sees no sun, and no sun sees the sea. ; A good dog on a dark day is still a good dog. ; The day came and the day went and still the man sat. ; The rain fell and the rain fed the seed. ; The dog ran and ran and ran. ; The sun was warm, and the dog was warm in the sun. ; The sun rose, and the dog sat in the sun. ; It is what it is, and it was what it was. ; Rain falls and rain falls as the dark rain falls. ; A cat ran on a mat. ; The deep rain fed the deep roots of the tall tree. ; The cat and the dog sat still. ; The tall tree grew green and the green tree grew tall. ; The man saw the sea and the sea saw the man. ; The sun rose and the sun set and the sea stayed still, and still the man sat. ; A good seed in good soil grows tall, and a tall tree gives good shade. ; The dog sat and the man sat and the rain fell on the sea and on the land. ; The rain came and the rain went and the rain came back, and the seed grew. ; The cat ran and the dog ran and the man ran, and the sun was warm on all of them. ; One dog and one cat and one man sat in the sun, and the day was long and good. ; The man saw the sea and the sea saw the man, and the day came and the day went. ; Good rain fed the good soil, and the seeds grew and the seeds grew tall. ; The tall tree and the tall grass grew in the rain, and the rain fed the deep roots. ; A warm day and a warm sun and a good dog on the mat, and the cat sat still. ; The sea was deep and the sea was dark, and the rain fell and the rain fed the sea. ; The day was good and the day was long, and the man sat in the sun and was warm. ; A tree grew and a seed fell and a tree grew, and the green tree grew tall. ; It was what it was and it is what it is, and all that is done is done. ; The dog was good and the day was dark, and the dog sat and the man sat. ; Rain on the sea and sun on the sea. ; The man sat still and the sea was still. ; The sun sees the sea and the sea sees the sun. ; The rain came and the rain went. ; The dog was good and the day was dark. ; A cat sat and a dog sat and the sun set. ; The man saw the dog and the dog saw the cat. ; The tree grew tall and the tall tree grew. ; A day well spent is a good day. ; The sun was warm and the warm sun rose. ; The dog ran on and on and on. ; Deep roots and deep rain and tall trees. ; The cat saw the dog and the dog saw the man. ; All is done and done is all. ; The green tree grew and the tree grew green. ; A seed grew and grew and grew tall. ; The cat ran and the dog ran and the man ran. ; The man saw all that the sea saw. ; The sun rose and the sun set. ; A dark day and a warm sun and a good dog. ; The day was good and the day was long. ; A tree grew and a seed fell. ; The sea was deep and the sea was dark. ; It was what it was and it is what it is. ; The rain fell on the good soil. ; The rain fell soft on the dark sea. ; A good cat sat on a warm mat. ; The man and the dog saw the sun set. ; The seed grew and the tree grew and the rain came. ; All that is done is done, and the day was good. ; The sun was warm and the sea was deep and still. ; A tall tree and a tall seed grew in the good soil. ; The dog ran on the mat and the cat ran on the mat. ; The day came and the rain came and the seed grew. ; It was a good day and the man was warm. ; The cat saw the sea and the dog saw the sea. ; Rain on the soil and sun on the soil. ; The man sat and the sea sat still. ; A warm sun rose on the deep sea. ; The green tree grew in the rain. ; The dog was good and the cat was good.

strings.name: lead_ins
strings.text: The seed grew. ; A tick of the clock. ; The owner smiled. ; The cat stayed alive. ; The score was tied. ; The summary was short. ; The seeds fell deep. ; A small tick moved. ; The owner came home. ; Still alive, the dog sat. ; The score stayed level. ; A short summary lay on the desk. ; The rain fed the seed. ; The tick of the clock was soft. ; The owner kept the key. ; Alive and warm, the cat slept. ; The score was close. ; The summary ended. ; A seed sat in the soil. ; The tick came at dawn.
